label: ExtremeSwitching X465-24XE
description: ExtremeSwitching X465-24XE - 24x 1G/10G SFP+ cages (unpopulated), MACsec and LRM capable, one empty VIM5 uplink slot, two 40G dedicated stacking ports (unpopulated), rear RJ-45 console and a 1G out-of-band management port; 888 Gbps aggregated switch bandwidth, 660.7 Mpps, no PoE and no copper access ports.

fabric.note: Extreme states 888 aggregated switch bandwidth and 660.7 frame forwarding rate for the X465-24XE (datasheet Performance and Scale table, https://extr-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/df5d3e48f1834936bc0d1caeae677c02?v=f38c16b6). The vendor figure counts the VIM5 uplink capacity and the two 40G stacking ports as well as the front panel, so it is larger than the aggregate of the Ethernet ports modelled here; nothing on the modelled ports is capped by it.

notes: The 10G fibre edge member: 24 x 1/10GbE SFP+ ports, MACsec and LRM capable, unpopulated, ports 1:1-1:24. SFP+ means a 1G SFP or a 10G SFP+ module in the same cage, which is why the template declares both rates. No PSE and no copper access ports. On this model VIM5-4X and VIM5-4XE run at 10G only (no 1G), while VIM5-4YE delivers its full 4x 25G. S1 and S2 are 2x 40G QSFP+ stacking ports on the front panel, 42 Gbps per link under SummitStack-V160; the stacking-support option is always enabled on the X465 and these are native stacking-only ports, so they are not modelled as Ethernet data ports. Console is the rear-panel RJ-45 serial port (plus a USB micro-B console that takes priority when connected), and the rear also carries a 10/100/1000BASE-T out-of-band management port, modelled as mgmt. Quad-core 2.1 GHz x86, 8 GB DDR4, 8 GB eMMC, 3 fan modules, 350 W PSU only. Idle 79 W, maximum 207 W. The vendor installation guide lists an SSD port only for the 24MU, 24MU-24W and 24MU-24W-class chassis, so none is claimed here. Sources: https://extr-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/df5d3e48f1834936bc0d1caeae677c02?v=f38c16b6, https://cdn.blueally.com/netsolutionstore/datasheets/switches/x465-series-data-sheet.pdf, https://documentation.extremenetworks.com/ExtremeSwitching%20Installation%20Guide%20for%20Switches%20Using%20ExtremeXOS%20Version%2030/Wired_Hardware/ExtremeSwitching_Installation_Guide_for_Switches_Using_ExtremeXOS_Version_30/topics/extremeswitching_x465_series_switches_technical_specifications.shtml, https://documentation.extremenetworks.com/ExtremeSwitching%20Installation%20Guide%20for%20Switches%20Using%20ExtremeXOS%20Version%2030/Wired_Hardware/ExtremeSwitching_Installation_Guide_for_Switches_Using_ExtremeXOS_Version_30/topics/extremeswitching_x465_series_switches.shtml, https://documentation.extremenetworks.com/ExtremeSwitching%20Installation%20Guide%20for%20Switches%20Using%20ExtremeXOS%20Version%2030/Universal_Hardware/Universal_Hardware_Common/topics/build_stacks/extremeswitching_x465_stacking.shtml.
